title: Loyalty, Cohesion, Factionalism & Internal Politics
objective: Deliver a bounded read-only, profile/context-driven projection for loyalty, cohesion, factionalism and internal-politics state over explicit visible canonical-owner observations while keeping MIB-09 relationship/reputation truth authoritative, keeping ODL-02 pressure advisory-only, and preventing automatic faction creation, relationship mutation, political outcomes, command authority or permission escalation.

red.failure: ODL-03 invariants and workspace install passed. Client typecheck then failed on self-hosted Linux and Windows because the production contract and panel were intentionally absent; derivative implicit-any diagnostics came from the missing imported production types. Cross-platform comparison matched the intended RED state.

application.first_production_failure: Focused regression passed 8/9; the only failure was duplicate visible provenance rendering in the accessible panel. Projection and authority semantics passed.

governed_contract.observation_rule: Only explicit visible owner-referenced qualitative observations with subject, dimension, profile, context, provenance and visibility references participate; ODL-02 pressure, counts, titles, hierarchy, labels, money, location and elapsed time do not imply ODL-03 state.
governed_contract.resolution_rule: After visibility filtering, compatible observed evidence resolves only when one band/profile/context tuple agrees. Missing or explicit-unknown remains unknown; incompatible-only remains incompatible; divergent or mixed evidence remains conflict; canonical-owner contradictions are never auto-resolved.
governed_contract.pressure_context_rule: Visible ODL-02 pressure is separately labeled advisory context only and never changes an ODL-03 state or automatically creates disloyalty, factionalism or political outcomes.
governed_contract.relationship_rule: MIB-09 relationship/reputation truth remains canonical and is never mutated by ODL-03.
governed_contract.faction_rule: ODL-03 creates no faction, derives no membership and mutates no faction membership.
governed_contract.political_outcome_rule: No coup, split, mutiny, crisis, fragmentation, leadership replacement, succession or command restriction is adjudicated by ODL-03.
governed_contract.permission_rule: Organization/faction/role/title/band labels grant no system permission, action authority or autonomous command authority.
governed_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized motives, relationships, factions, observations, profile/context and advisory data are filtered before states, counts, summaries, search, provenance, receipts or AI context; hidden cardinality is undisclosed.
governed_contract.persistence: No durable ODL-03 persistence, duplicate ledger or migration 0022.

preserved_boundaries: ODL-01/02 remain completed_verified and are not reopened.
Canonical Organization/Faction/Relationship/Reputation, Character, WCI, DPL, Project/time/context and Permission/visibility owners remain authoritative.

No owner, relationship/reputation or faction mutation, automatic pressure conversion, political outcome, command/permission authority, campaign-time advancement, duplicate ledger, durable persistence or migration 0022 was introduced.
ODL-04 is successor selection only; ODL-05+, SCL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.

One bounded UI-only repair removed the redundant duplicate without changing the acceptance contract or projection semantics.
changed_since_previous: Removed only the redundant global provenance list from the ODL-03 panel; acceptance test and authority semantics were unchanged.
Exact-head self-hosted Linux/Windows and deterministic comparison then all passed.
